tenderSchedule.title: NIGHT SHELTER FOR URBAN HOMELESS PEOPLE
tenderSchedule.description: RFP for NIGHT SHELTER FOR URBAN HOMELESS PEOPLE in CMC Kolar Limits

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have minimum 2 years experience of working for welfare of community or Urban poor running orphanage 24x7 urban homeless shelter etc., Certificate duly certified by the not below the rank of executive engineer.
The bidder must be a registered NGO / civil group, registered under the provisions of the different Laws with in Karnataka and should be renewed for the current year

NGO should have well equipped office in CMC Kolar Limits. Also they should have specialized qualified staff to guide and formulate comprehensive projects related to night shelters as per government guidelines. Also they must have experience in preparing reports which would be submitted to government. And submit working staff details with resume and qualification testimonials as per prescribed formats

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have an average annual turnover of Rs.4.00 lakhs at least in any 2 years during last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26.(Should have an acknowledgement of Income tax returns filed and Audited reports in the last 02 Years)
